company.name: Nexthink
company.shortDescription: Nexthink is a software company that assists enterprises create digital workplaces for their employees by using Agentic-AI and IT.
company.description:
Nexthink is a global leader in digital experience management. 

The company's product allows enterprises to create highly productive digital workplaces for their employees by delivering optimal end-user experience. Through a unique combination of real-time analytics, automation and employee feedback across all endpoints, Nexthink helps IT teams meet the needs of the modern digital workplace.

productsAndServices.description: A digital employee experience (DEX) management platform that combines workforce technology observability, experience data, analytics, automation, and AI-powered IT agents.

productsAndServices.name: Nexthink Workplace Experience

productsAndServices.description: An employee-facing AI IT agent that provides conversational assistance and can help resolve common technology issues directly in the employee workflow.
productsAndServices.name: Nexthink Spark

productsAndServices.description: An automation capability for creating workflows that streamline IT operations, remediate issues, and improve service desk and workplace processes.
productsAndServices.name: Nexthink Flow

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring and optimization capability for understanding application performance, availability, usage, and its effect on employee experience.
productsAndServices.name: Nexthink Application Experience

aiResearchSummary.text: Nexthink is researching systems and methods for quantifying digital experiences, focusing on receiving technology performance data such as endpoint data to identify operational aspects of client devices. Their work centers on determining a user's digital experience, aligning with their goal of delivering optimal end-user experience in digital workplaces. This area of research and development emphasizes measuring and analyzing digital experience through technology performance data.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $750,000,000, or 68.44% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,016,421 to $1,101,460,942, a 1083.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
